title: ICSI CSEET October 2026 Results: Declaration on November 15th!
content:
# ICSI CSEET October 2026 Results: Declaration on November 15th!

Ek important update hai Company Secretary Executive Entrance Test (CSEET) aspirants ke liye! The Institute of Company Secretaries of India (ICSI) ne October 2026 session ke results ki official declaration date announce kar di hai.

Yeh ek fast update hai taaki aapko latest information mil sake:

*   **What:** ICSI CSEET October 2026 Session Results.
*   **When:** Results will be declared on **Sunday, November 15, 2026, at 2:00 PM IST**.
*   **Where:** Candidates can check their results on the official ICSI website, `www.icsi.edu`.
*   **How to Check:** You will need to use your roll number and registration number to log in and view your e-Result-cum-Marks Statement.
*   **Important Note:** ICSI will upload the formal e-Result-cum-Marks Statement online, and no physical copy will be dispatched to candidates.

Toh, prepare rahiye aur apne credentials ready rakhiye!

## Read the Official Document
*   [Check the official ICSI website for updates and results here](https://www.icsi.edu/)

*Published on: 13 November 2026*
